method: Generate original paintover constrained by the actual frozen mesh render, then deterministically register and inspect it before any texture bake. This replaces projection of mismatched separately posed concept images; it is not another anchor correction.

mode_inference_decision.rationale: Production texture source must match the fixed 3D silhouette and plate creases; test one front image before expanding views.

alpha_policy: Opaque exact dark studio background is an intentional exception for camera-matched projection reference. It will not be published directly. Texture sampling will use the actual rendered mesh mask; no key-color convention is needed.
invariants: Original helmet and shoulder silhouette, mesh proportions, visor and plate-groove locations, frontal camera, crop and pose
Silver steel, narrow brass trim, navy cloth and existing original sun crest only
No third-party mesh, rig or motion
qa_gates: Pin input/output hashes and full prompt
Inspect silhouette registration and visor/plate-edge alignment against the actual mesh
No baked heavy cast shadows, new armor silhouettes, text, watermark or extra equipment
Do not produce further views or bake unless front paintover is viable; retain failed evidence
source_review: partial-reference: material language only, not direct whole-image projection
